policies.scope: direct writes to provider APIs outside the approved engine path
policies.description: Deny direct API writes. All provider-API mutations must flow through the approved engine path; ad-hoc direct writes are never permitted.

policies.scope: any data egress to an external system or party
policies.description: Deny external egress unless an exact G1 authorization exists for the specific payload and destination. No standing or implied authorization suffices.

policies.scope: promotion of synthetic or sandbox-generated artifacts into any live pipeline, queue, or ledger
policies.description: Deny promotion of synthetic-to-live data under all circumstances. Sandbox output never enters live state; no authorization can override this.

policies.scope: any machine representation of a human decision, signature, approval, or attestation
policies.description: Deny machine impersonation of human decisions. Approvals, signatures, and attestations must come from the human; the machine records, never asserts.

policies.scope: publication or external release of any artifact, payload, or document
policies.description: Deny publication unless the exact release hash (of the byte-identical artifact) is authorized. Authorization for a similar or prior artifact does not transfer.

policies.scope: promotion of the keel_0_8 build / pilot candidate to live or gated status
policies.description: Deny keel_0_8 promotion unless ALL six predicates hold simultaneously: six authentic sources, cross-record validation PASS, genuine operator decision PRESENT, assurance PASS, trust PASS, consent PASS. Partial satisfaction is a deny.
